approved_amendments.scope: Prepare a release authorization request and contract for the restored admin dashboard candidate.
limits: This approval authorizes preparation of the request only.
A stewardship-issued release contract is required before release-gate execution.
No deployment, merge, publication, or production data change is authorized by this draft.

execution.objective: Obtain EOS and stewardship authorization for the exact admin dashboard candidate before release-gate execution.
success_criteria: Reconcile the candidate with the active work-cycle authority without repurposing the REP-STEWARD-029 hygiene cycle.
Obtain the applicable approval through the established EOS process.
Obtain a stewardship-issued release contract bound to the verified candidate base, head, and exact paths.
Keep the release gate, existing contracts, application code, and production data unchanged until authorization is complete.
Do not merge, publish, or deploy during this authorization-request cycle.
proposed_outputs: A separately approved dashboard release WCS and authority record.
A stewardship-issued release contract with digest bound to this exact candidate.
The required release-source certification and digest evidence, if mandated by EOS.

depends_on: REP-STEWARD-029-WCS-001 hygiene authority must remain separate and unchanged.
unlocks: Run the authorized release gate after the required approvals and contract are recorded.

forbidden_surface: Release guard or EOS evaluator changes

founder_runtime_test.test_definition: No runtime changes or production operations are authorized.
founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: A draft EOS authorization request is ready for review.
